entities.name: Beethoven's Ninth Symphony
entities.label: Text
entities.summary: Ludwig van Beethoven's final complete symphony (1824), revolutionary for incorporating vocal soloists and chorus (Schiller's "Ode to Joy") into a symphonic work. Composed while Beethoven was nearly deaf, the Ninth expanded the boundaries of orchestral music and its "Ode to Joy" theme was adopted as the anthem of the European Union, symbolizing universal brotherhood.
